description: Identifier-exact path:line set over this repo's own source. Labels were written by reading the code at the pinned commit, not by running the resolver. expect: block (each listed path:line comes with its whole block), pointers (exactly these path:line, no body), empty (nothing). Each at entry is path:line-endLine, the declaration's span (comments above excluded) taken from the TypeScript compiler's syntax tree at the commit. subset exact: prompts that name a symbol the way the spec describes, so they check the spec is implemented. subset hard: written before any run; plain-language questions, sloppy names, lone PascalCase words and code-shaped words that aren't definitions here. A name the index can't match exactly, like a string literal or a typo, is labeled empty even when a human could guess the place: the resolver must not guess. Prompts with ids starting v2- were added later: each carries a source, either a commit of this repo (gold from the syntax tree at that commit, where the test fixtures' template strings are not definitions) or npm:picomatch@4.0.7 (read from node_modules, never edited; gold from the syntax tree, plus two property-assigned functions labeled by hand). subset empty-code: should-be-empty coding prompts (names that don't exist here, generic programming questions naming standard-library calls, prose). Written before the packet wiring was scored.
index: every git-tracked .ts/.tsx/.js/.mjs/.py/.go file at the commit; for a v2- prompt, its source
split: held-out when FNV-1a(id) % 3 == 0, dev otherwise; tune only on dev
